title: GBRG Containment Proof Artifact
description: Governance-native result of a sever/residual-reachability read. Answers: from a foothold, what was reachable, what remains after isolation (residual), and what the sever contained. Topology-agnostic — the same artifact covers code-boundary severing and network host isolation.
$comment: Converged onto the estate-canonical ProofArtifact v1 (standards-storage#97, remediation R2): binds via allOf to https://schemas.socioprophet.ai/proof-artifact/v1.json and $refs its epistemicLevel enum from $defs instead of copy-pasting it. The canonical is sovereign-vendored at contracts/vendor/proof-artifact/proof-artifact.schema.v1.json. epistemicLevel is the proof-CONFIDENCE axis, distinct from any autonomy/authority band: a real containment traversal over the frozen index is 'empirical'; a sever that contained nothing is downgraded to 'speculative' so a no-op isolation is never presented as a settled result.

source.description: The foothold node the reachability was computed from (hex node id).

scope.description: Sever scope applied. Mirror of severedScope; retained for symmetry with the reading.

severedScope.description: full = cut all edges from the isolated node(s) but allow-listed control channels; selective = keep only the excluded (kept-label) edges traversable.

baselineReachableCount.description: Nodes reachable from source BEFORE the sever.

residualReachableCount.description: Nodes reachable from source AFTER the sever (the residual).

containedCount.description: baselineReachableCount - residualReachableCount: what the sever contained.

residualReachable.description: The residual reachable node ids (hex). For a full isolation these are the allow-listed control channels (EDR/EPP + exclusions).

derivation.description: Human-readable explanation of WHY this containment holds.

declaredBy.description: Producing agent identity, resolvable in the agent-registry.
